deals.title: Dune: Adventures in the Imperium - Core Rulebook (Standard Edition)
deals.summary: The full Dune RPG hardcover for 5 pounds in Modiphius' warehouse clearance, until stock runs out.
deals.notes: Shop page showed GBP 5.00 and 'In stock'; the 50 GBP regular price comes from the EN World report of 2026-09-21, not the shop page. Sale runs until stock sells out; Modiphius warns of shipping delays. Store currency selector offers USD/CAD.

reviews.verdict: Recommends it even to non-fans; the shared Great House and House-versus-House intrigue is a risk that pays off.
Excellent game of narrative intrigue and action for fans of the books and films; misses random events for dynastic play.

deals.title: Blue Fox Cthulhu
deals.summary: Nine Blue Fox Mythos titles for $17.95: three Cthulhu gamebooks plus graphic novels based on Lovecraft stories, so it suits Cthulhu fans who like solo and story-driven reading.
deals.notes: Mostly gamebooks and graphic novels, not RPG rulebooks, so borderline for a tabletop RPG site. Single flat price. Ends Thu 2026-10-29 07:59 EDT per the page countdown.

deals.title: Cthulhu Awakens
deals.summary: The complete Cthulhu Awakens core rulebook (a Mythos RPG built on the AGE system) plus the Revelations of the Bacchae scenario for $12.95; paying over $21.22 adds a bonus set of six more titles including Cults of the Mythos and Fantasy AGE Cthulhu Mythos.
deals.notes: Two tiers: starter $12.95 (retail $53), bonus collection unlocked above $21.22 (total retail $121). Ends Tue 2026-10-27 07:59 EDT per the page countdown.

reviews.verdict: Calls it a Cthulhu game breaking new ground, but wants summary charts for the dense rules and finds the sample adventures uneven.

deals.title: Knock! Magazine Bundle
deals.summary: Three full issues of the KNOCK! tabletop RPG magazine (about 650 pages of system-neutral adventures, tools and ideas) as DRM-free PDFs for one flat price, about a quarter of retail.
deals.notes: Single flat price, no tiers. Ends Tue 2026-10-20 07:59 EDT per the page countdown. Ends in 4 days, so show it soon or drop it.

reviews.verdict: Calls issue #1 a strong, dense OSR collection and a treasure trove for GMs; minor typos and glossy finish.

deals.title: Monster Hunters of the Week Bundle
deals.summary: The Monster of the Week 2023 Revised core rulebook plus the Slayer's Survival Kit and Hunter's Journal for $14.95; paying over $29.28 adds five more books including Codex of Worlds and Tome of Mysteries.
deals.notes: Two tiers: Hunter Collection $14.95 (retail $60), Keeper Collection unlocked above $29.28 (total retail $127). Ends Tue 2026-11-03 06:59 EST per the page countdown.

reviews.verdict: Top recommendation of the new hardback; a go-to game for learning PbtA and onboarding new players.
Loves it as a showcase of Powered by the Apocalypse design; great for one-shot mysteries and introducing newcomers.

deals.title: Pathfinder Roleplaying Game: Planar Adventures (1e)
deals.summary: A Pathfinder 1e planar sourcebook at 70% off in Paizo's Fall Clearance.
deals.notes: Seen on Paizo's Pathfinder First Edition sale page 2026-10-16 ('Add to cart'). No end date shown; clearance stock is limited.

reviews.verdict: Calls it a solid setting sourcebook with long shelf life, useful for both First and Second Edition players.

deals.title: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide (PFRPG) Hardcover
deals.summary: The classic Golarion world guide for Pathfinder 1e at 70% off in the Paizo Fall Clearance.
deals.notes: Seen on Paizo's sale page 2026-10-16 ('Add to cart'). No end date shown.

reviews.verdict: Calls it the most complete fantasy setting he has seen and recommends it to veterans and newcomers alike.

deals.title: Enter the Survival Horror
deals.summary: A Forged in the Dark survival-horror RPG about limited supplies and monsters, 60% off.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 5.0/5 from 33 ratings.

reviews.verdict: Likes how it adapts Blades in the Dark mechanics to survival horror, especially the find-what-you-need loot idea.

deals.title: Hesitation at the Gate
deals.summary: A tarot-based RPG about seeking enlightenment in a mystical city-state, half price in the Spooky Season Salestravaganza.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 4.9/5 from only 15 ratings.

deals.title: Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook (OGL) Pocket Edition
deals.summary: The Pathfinder 1e core rules in a pocket-size edition at half price from Paizo's Fall Clearance.
deals.notes: Seen on Paizo's sale page 2026-10-16 ('Add to cart'). No end date shown.

reviews.verdict: Same content as the big book, cheaper and easier to carry; deep customization, but complex and it wears with use.
Loves Pathfinder; the pocket edition trades some readability and lay-flat use for portability and a lower price.

deals.title: Bar the Windows, Bolt the Doors
deals.game: Bar the Windows, Bolt the Doors
deals.summary: A GM-less horror RPG where 2 to 6 players defend a remote cabin from monsters until dawn, 40% off in the October Sale 2026.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 5.0/5 from 22 ratings.

deals.title: Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition (PDF) and all World of Darkness PDFs, 40% off
deals.summary: World of Darkness PDFs on DriveThruRPG and Storytellers Vault are 40% off all month, including the V5 core book and its sourcebooks.
deals.notes: Shop page blocked (403). Official Paradox 'Month of Darkness' post dated 2026-10-01 says 40% off PDFs 'all month long'. Link is the V5 core book page (from search results), not the sale listing. Core book list price was about USD 24.99 in a search snippet, unverified.

reviews.verdict: A pretty good edition with renewed horror focus; dislikes dropped original clans and heavy in-universe fiction.

deals.title: Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition Digital Compendiums for Demiplane (40% off, code WOD2026)
deals.summary: Digital compendiums for Vampire and other World of Darkness games on Demiplane are 40% off with a checkout code.
deals.notes: Demiplane page loads with JavaScript only, so no price seen. Paradox post dated 2026-10-01: use code WOD2026 at checkout; excludes bundles and physical books; no end date stated (Month of Darkness runs through October).

reviews.verdict: Likes the linked navigation for fast rules lookups, wants a hyperlinked glossary, sees online rules sites as the industry's future.
Pretty good edition with renewed horror focus; wishes it kept all original Clans and used less in-universe fiction.

deals.title: Treasures of the Troll King for MORK BORG
deals.summary: A sewer-crawl adventure for MORK BORG hunting the sunken chapel of the exiled troll king, 34% off.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum, in GBP. Includes two PDFs. Sale end date not shown. Rating 5.0/5 from 50 ratings. The creator's other Mork Borg adventures show the same 34% off.

reviews.verdict: Ran it over three online sessions; dark, weird, easy to run, art and layout match the core book.

deals.title: Book of Hexcrawl 1-6 Bundle (PDF)
deals.summary: Six hexcrawl books from Kobold Press (system-neutral wilderness exploration toolkits) in one PDF bundle for a third off.
deals.notes: Price and regular price seen on the shop page, which sits in the store's On Sale section; no end date shown and unclear how long this standing sale lasts.

deals.title: The Tomb Beneath the Red Sands
deals.summary: A 230-page dark desert-fantasy adventure for 5e-style play (levels 1 to 8, about 10 sessions), 30% off the digital edition.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. No ratings shown on the page.

deals.title: Questlandia: 2nd Edition
deals.summary: A GM-less fantasy RPG played with cards and d6s where you build a kingdom's society and then play through its collapse, 30% off in the Fall Sale.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 5.0/5 from 13 ratings.

deals.title: Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook
deals.summary: The Power Rangers RPG core book at 30% off on the publisher's own store, listed in Bellhop's 'last chance' section.
deals.notes: Shop page showed $38.50 with 'Was' $55.00. Stock shown blank; no end date. Bellhop (2026-10-14) put it under 'last chance'.

deals.title: Lord of the Rings RPG Starter Set
deals.game: The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying Game
deals.summary: Free League's boxed starter set for the Lord of the Rings RPG at 30% off at Barnes & Noble.
deals.notes: Barnes & Noble page showed $20.99 vs $29.99 (Save 30%) on 2026-10-16. Starter set includes print rules and dice, so format is boxed print. No end date.

reviews.verdict: A confident, accessible entry to Tolkien roleplaying; best for D&D veterans and Tolkien fans, newcomers may need guidance.
Calls it a great way to jump into the Lord of the Rings roleplaying world.

deals.title: Book of Blades for 5th Edition: Complete Digital Bundle (PDF)
deals.summary: Twelve 5e martial-class and combat supplements (warfare, naval battles, weapons and armor) in one PDF bundle, 30% off.
deals.notes: Price and regular price seen on the shop page; no end date shown and unclear how long this standing sale lasts.

deals.title: Apothecaria
deals.summary: A very well-rated cozy solo journaling RPG where you play a village witch brewing potions, now 25% off in the creator's Spooky Sale.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown on the page. Rating 4.9/5 from 393 ratings.

reviews.verdict: A genuinely lovely cosy solo game, though the layout splits and misplaces rules explanations.
Favourable: a relaxing writing game that could help with writer's block.
Superb, relaxing and cosy; balances structured rules with creative freedom and may help aspiring writers.

deals.title: For Small Creatures Such As We
deals.game: For Small Creatures Such As We
deals.summary: A solo or co-op sci-fi card-driven RPG about captaining a mixed human and alien crew, 25% off in the Spooky Sale.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 4.9/5 from 169 ratings.

reviews.verdict: Accessible sci-fi game with sci-fi influences; a must-play, especially for Star Wars RPG fans.

deals.title: Thirsty Sword Lesbians Delightful Duo Bundle (hardcovers)
deals.summary: Thirsty Sword Lesbians and Advanced Lovers & Lesbians hardcovers bundled with a discount.
deals.notes: Shop page showed $69.00 but the regular price and 'You save' amount were blank. The 20% off hardcovers figure comes from Tabletop Bellhop (updated 2026-10-14). No end date.

reviews.verdict: Well designed and mostly fun with praised safety tools, but some moves and the Strings mechanic frustrated his group.
Calls it a great addition to current Powered by the Apocalypse games and plans to run it at cons.

deals.title: Field Guide to Monster Harvesting Collection (PDF)
deals.summary: Two 5e PDFs on crafting with monster parts and magical ingredients, covering 700+ creatures, for 20% off.
deals.notes: Price and regular price seen on the shop page; no end date shown and unclear how long this standing sale lasts.

deals.title: Dead Letter Society
deals.summary: A vampire RPG where you are the newest member of a secret communication network for the undead, 18% off in the creator's 'Turning 45' sale.
deals.notes: Price is a pay-what-you-want minimum. Sale end date not shown. Rating 5.0/5 from 64 ratings. Modest discount.

reviews.verdict: Strongly positive: thorough world creation, excellent atmosphere, lovely art and layout, plus a solo variant.
Enthusiastic: a dream for vampire pen-pals, free choice of vampire and world, intuitive system, beautiful book.

deals.title: Dune: Adventures in the Imperium - Gamemaster's Toolkit
deals.summary: The Dune GM toolkit (screen and aids) for 5 pounds in the Modiphius clearance.
deals.notes: Price seen on collection page 2026-10-16; regular price not shown. Stock not checked on the product page.

deals.title: Odyssey of the Dragonlords: Hardcover Adventure Book
deals.summary: A hardcover campaign book from the Modiphius clearance, roughly half off.
deals.notes: Shop page showed GBP 22.50 and 'Only 18 units left'. Regular price not shown (about GBP 45 inferred from the page's malformed 'Save' label), so left null.

reviews.source: What Do I Know About Reviews?
reviews.verdict: Qualified recommendation: a beautiful book with many strengths, but know what you are getting before buying.

deals.title: Dishonored Gamemaster Toolkit
deals.summary: Gamemaster toolkit for the Dishonored RPG at GBP 7.50 in the Modiphius warehouse clearance, with only a few copies left.
deals.notes: Regular price not shown on the page (sale badge is malformed). Only 6 units left when checked. Runs until stock is gone.
